description: This file defines the FaultableConsumerGrain class which implements a grain in Orleans for consuming streams, with mechanisms for error handling and failure simulation.

classes.name: FaultableConsumerGrain
classes.description: A Grain implementation for a fault-tolerant stream consumer with failure simulation capabilities.

methods.name: FaultableConsumerGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger for the grain.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method invoked upon grain activation, initializes counters and reset state.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal counters and stream handle to initial state.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method invoked upon deactivation, logs deactivation.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Configures the grain to subscribe to a specified stream using provided stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: SetFailPeriod
methods.description: Sets a failure period during which the grain simulates failures in stream processing.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the stream, stopping consumption.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the total number of successfully consumed events.

methods.name: GetNumberFailed
methods.description: Returns the total number of failed events.

methods.name: GetErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of errors encountered.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream events, with failure simulation based on timer.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error events, increments error count.
